description: Spring Boot controller class handling user profile viewing and editing, including authentication checks and interactions with user and enrollment repositories.

classes.name: SecurityController
classes.description: Controller managing user profile display and updates with security checks.

methods.name: getUserProfile
methods.description: Handles GET request to display current user's profile, including enrolled courses.

methods.name: getForEdit
methods.description: Handles GET request to retrieve user data for editing, with authentication validation.

methods.name: updateUser
methods.description: Handles POST request to update user information after authentication validation.

methods.name: patchUser
methods.description: Handles POST request to partially update user details after authentication validation.
